executive_summary.headline: NYC Couple's Vacation Analysis (Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027)
core_findings: Optimal 7-Night Window: Shift 6 days later from Feb 15–22 to Sun Feb 21 – Sun Feb 28, 2027 (or Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1). You dodge Presidents' Day (Feb 15) + NYC Public Schools Midwinter Recess crowds (Feb 15–19) while locking in February hotel troughs ($931–$1,623 all-in for 7 nights) before March rates jump +28% to +57%.

Top Transit & Michelin Hotel (#1 Rank): LUMA Hotel Times Square ($0 Amenity Fee, King/2-Queen w/ private bath) reaches 70/70 NYC MICHELIN-Starred + 78 Bib Gourmand (148 total) within <=60 min by subway/bus, with Sushi Sho (3★) and Gabriel Kreuther (2★) literally on the same 41st St corridor. Best all-in 4★ value: Arlo Midtown ($1,095–$1,305/7n) or Arlo NoMad ($1,218/7n); best total-cost saver: Hampton Inn Brooklyn/Downtown ($931/7n w/ $0 fee & free hot breakfast).

Critical 2027 Calendar Alerts Verified: (1) Metropolitan Opera has ZERO performances Jan 31 – Mar 7, 2027 (reopens Mar 8); (2) Wollman Rink closes for the season Mar 16, 2027; (3) The Met is closed Wednesdays, Whitney is closed Tuesdays, 9/11 Museum is closed most winter Tuesdays, and Sushi Sho / Jungsik / Jean-Georges / Dirt Candy / Aska / Morgan Library / Broadway are closed Mondays (Presidents' Day Feb 15!).

7-Night Couple Total Budget (2 Adults, Excl. Flights): Budget/Smart Tier ~$2,250–$2,950 | Boutique Mid-Tier ~$3,650–$4,850 | Splurge MICHELIN Tier ~$6,200–$8,900+ (includes 7-night hotel w/ all taxes & mandatory resort fees, $70 OMNY 7-day capped transit for 2, verified activities, and MICHELIN dining).

transit_fact.seven_day_cap: $35.00/person ($70.00 couple total for 7 days via OMNY; each adult MUST tap their own separate contactless card/phone)

known_confirmed: Mandatory room specs: En-suite private bathroom + Queen bed or larger (Queen or King).
Outer travel window: February 15, 2027 – March 23, 2027 (preferred start Feb 15–18, 2027).
Hotel pricing comparison baseline: Standardized 7-night stay.
Transit threshold: Planned activities <= 60 minutes from hotel; hotels ranked by MICHELIN Guide venues <= 60 minutes by subway/bus.
Official NYC taxes & transit: 14.75% + $3.50/night hotel tax; $3.00 MTA OMNY fare capped at $35.00/7 days per person.
missing_unconfirmed: Exact trip duration: Prompt mentions 3 nights (Feb 15–18), 1–2 weeks (7–14 nights), AND possibly 2–4 weeks (14–28 nights).
Total trip budget ceiling & split between lodging vs. MICHELIN fine dining (e.g., one 3★ splurge at $700–$990 vs. multiple 1★/Bib Gourmand dinners at $62–$290).
Origin airport, flight arrival/departure times, and whether ESTA / US visa + passport validity (6+ months) are already secured (especially if flying internationally from NL/Europe — AMS–JFK/EWR).

Dietary restrictions, allergies, or alcohol preferences (critical: Joo Ok 2★ cannot accommodate vegetarian, gluten-free, shellfish, seaweed, or allium restrictions; Eleven Madison Park 3★ & Dirt Candy 1★ offer world-class plant-based menus).

Sleep/space sensitivity: Whether a compact 150–170 sq ft smart cabin (Arlo / Pod Queen / citizenM wall-to-wall King) is comfortable for 1–4 weeks, or if 250–345+ sq ft (LUMA / Hyatt Centric / Ace Medium King / Hampton Inn) is required.

Flexibility to shift arrival 4–10 days earlier (Jan 19 – Feb 11, 2027) to capture 25% off NYC Hotel Week + 2-for-1 Broadway Week + NYC Restaurant Week, OR shift after Mar 8, 2027 if Metropolitan Opera is a priority.

decision_questions.question: Are we locking in 3–4 nights (Feb 15–18), 7 nights, 14 nights, or 21–28 nights — and can we shift arrival to Feb 21, 2027?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: Feb 15–19 overlaps Presidents' Day + NYC Public Schools Midwinter Recess (museum crowds) and Monday closures. Shifting to Feb 21–28 saves money and crowds; staying 28+ nights triggers different NYC occupancy-tax rules and favors apartment-style suites (e.g., Pod Pad w/ kitchen) or splitting Manhattan + Brooklyn.
decision_questions.answer_needed_before: Booking flights and locking non-refundable hotel rates (aim to decide by Dec 15, 2026).
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Compare both partners' PTO/remote-work calendars across Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027, and price round-trip flights (e.g., Google Flights matrix for AMS/local hub -> JFK/EWR) for 7n vs. 14n vs. 21n.

decision_questions.question: How many starred tasting menus do we want to book, and does either partner have dietary restrictions or dress-code preferences?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: Three-star tastings run $670–$990 base per couple and release on strict schedules: Sushi Sho (3★) is ALREADY open through Feb 28, 2027 on Tock right now; Le Bernardin, EMP, Atomix & Aska drop Feb 2027 tables on Jan 1, 2027. Joo Ok (2★) strictly declines gluten-free, vegetarian, shellfish, and allium modifications, while Le Bernardin & Jean-Georges enforce smart-casual/jacket rules.
decision_questions.answer_needed_before: Now (for Sushi Sho Feb 2027 Tock slots) and before January 1, 2027 at 7:00 AM / 12:00 PM ET (for Feb 2027 Resy/Tock drops).
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Pick 1–2 'anchor' 2★/3★ splurges + 2–3 approachable 1★/Bib Gourmand spots from michelin.html, confirm dietary restrictions together, and create Resy + Tock accounts with payment cards saved in advance.

decision_questions.question: For a 1–4 week stay with winter coats and luggage, what is our minimum comfortable room square footage?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: NYC's sharpest Manhattan bargains (Arlo Midtown $1,095/7n, Pod Queen $980–$1,290/7n, Arlo NoMad $1,218/7n, citizenM) are 150–175 sq ft micro-luxury cabins. For 7 nights they are great; for 14–28 nights with winter parkas and two checked bags, 250–345 sq ft rooms (LUMA, Hyatt Centric, Ace Medium Queen/King, Hampton Inn) prevent cabin fever.
decision_questions.answer_needed_before: Selecting the final hotel tier (book refundable hold in Dec 2026).
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Watch the linked 4K room walkthrough videos on hotels.html together (especially citizenM wall-to-wall King and Pod Queen walkthroughs) and measure 150 sq ft (~12×12.5 ft) at home.

decision_questions.question: Is seeing an opera at The Metropolitan Opera OR ice skating at Wollman Rink on our must-do list?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: They pull in opposite directions of the calendar! Met Opera is DARK Jan 31 – Mar 7, 2027 (reopens Mar 8), whereas Wollman Rink CLOSES for the season on Mar 16, 2027. Only the overlap week of March 8–16, 2027 allows BOTH on one 7-night trip (at higher March hotel rates)!
decision_questions.answer_needed_before: Finalizing February vs. March 2027 travel dates.
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Review the 2026–27 Met Opera lineup (Silent Night, Aida, Manon starting Mar 8 on metopera.org) vs. February Broadway options (Hadestown runs all Feb & Mar) and hotel savings ($300–$740 cheaper in Feb).

decision_questions.question: Do we want Statue of Liberty Crown Reserve tickets ($25.50/pp) or free museum Friday evening slots?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: Crown Reserve tickets cost the exact same $25.50/adult as general ferry tickets on official Statue City Cruises, but tiny daily quotas sell out 60–90+ days ahead (Dec 2026 for Feb/Mar 2027).
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Check live Crown Reserve availability for your target dates directly on cityexperiences.com/new-york/city-cruises/statue/.

decision_questions.category: Loyalty Points, Credit Cards & International Entry
decision_questions.question: Do we hold World of Hyatt / Marriott Bonvoy / Hilton Honors points or Chase/Amex transfer partners, and are passports/ESTA current?
decision_questions.why_it_matters: Redeeming World of Hyatt points at Hyatt Centric Times Square or Hilton points at Hampton Inn automatically WAIVES mandatory $45.91/night destination fees AND 14.75% NYC hotel taxes! International travelers also need approved ESTA ($21 official DHS site only) at least 72+ hours prior.
decision_questions.answer_needed_before: Paying cash or locking prepaid rates.
decision_questions.how_to_discover: Audit both partners' credit card/hotel point balances and check passport expiration dates + official esta.cbp.dhs.gov status.

reviewable_suggestions.title: Adopt the 'Two-Step Refundable Lock + 25-Day Re-Shop' Hotel Strategy
reviewable_suggestions.impact: High ($150–$450 est. savings w/ zero downside)
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: Book a 100% refundable 'Pay Later' Queen/King room now (late Nov / Dec 2026) for Feb 21–28, 2027 (and/or Feb 15–22 if fixed) directly with the hotel, then set a calendar reminder for Jan 25, 2027 (3–4 weeks out) to re-check winter distress inventory before the free-cancellation deadline.
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Refundable rates initially price ~$15–$28/night above non-refundable prepay rates, so confirm whether date flexibility or lowest upfront price is your priority before locking non-refundable.

reviewable_suggestions.title: If Staying 14–28 Nights, Use a 'Midtown + Neighborhood' Split Stay Instead of One Hotel
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: For a 2–4 week trip, pair Week 1 in Midtown/Bryant Park (e.g., LUMA or Arlo Midtown for Broadway, MoMA, Central Park, Met, Midtown 3★/2★ dining) with Week 2 in NoMad/Bowery/Brooklyn (e.g., Arlo NoMad, citizenM Bowery, or Hampton Inn Brooklyn for Village, SoHo, LES, FiDi & Williamsburg dining).
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Requires one 20-minute subway/Uber hotel move mid-trip, vs. unpacking once.

reviewable_suggestions.title: Use MICHELIN 2★/3★ Lunch & Bar Tasting Menus to Cut Fine-Dining Spend by 45–60%
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: Book Le Bernardin's 3-course Lunch ($274 couple vs. $700 Chef's Tasting), Aquavit's 2/3-course Lunch ($160–$190 couple vs. $390 dinner), Jean-Georges' Lunch ($256 vs. $596), or Eleven Madison Park's Bar Tasting ($450 vs. $770) to experience multiple 2★/3★ kitchens at 1★ prices.
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Lunch/bar formats feature 3–4 courses instead of the full 7–10 course evening progression.

reviewable_suggestions.title: Add an Interactive 'Trip Length & Tier Cost Calculator' (3n / 7n / 14n / 28n)
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: Add a client-side calculator on the landing or hotels page that lets you toggle nights (3, 7, 14, 21, 28), hotel choice, number of starred dinners, and OMNY 7-day caps ($35/pp/wk) to see live all-in couple totals.
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Kept out of core verified tables for now so verified 7-night static figures aren't confused with modeled projections until you approve exact trip length.

reviewable_suggestions.title: Add a Day-by-Day 'Closed-Day Guardrail' Itinerary Builder + .ics Reservation Drop Calendar
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: Generate downloadable .ics calendar alerts for Dec 14, 2026 (new MICHELIN Star ceremony check!), Jan 1, 2027 7:00 AM ET (Feb Resy/Tock drops), and Feb 1, 2027 (Mar drops), plus a drag-and-drop itinerary grid that automatically blocks Monday fine-dining closures, Tuesday Whitney/9-11 closures, and Wednesday Met closures.
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Best built right after you lock your exact arrival & departure dates.

reviewable_suggestions.title: Add an Offline-Capable Cluster Map Pinning Selected Hotel + <=60-Min Subway Lines
reviewable_suggestions.proposal: Embed a lightweight Leaflet/OpenStreetMap view color-coding 3★, 2★, 1★, Bib Gourmand, Selected, and Activities around your chosen hotel with walking rings (10 min / 15 min) and direct subway lines.
reviewable_suggestions.tradeoff_to_review: Adds external map tile requests when online; review if preferred over zero-dependency offline tables.

flagged_irregularities.action_taken: Highlighted Sun Feb 21 – Sun Feb 28, 2027 as the superior crowd-free, cheaper 7-night window.
